requested_service.purpose: Fulfill a real inventory-check request or a narrowly matched Skubase support question.
process: Identify Skubase honestly without inventing a human identity
Answer only the requested service need
Disclose the current Shopify App Store review status
Bind the exact body to the request and source knowledge
Check suppression and dispatch authority immediately before sending
requested_service.output: One source-grounded service response and its durable dispatch record.
requested_service.success_signal: The requester completes the connection or resolves the requested service question.
requested_service.cost_expectation: Deterministic templates, zero model tokens. Legitimate requested-service replies are exempt from the rolling 20-new-merchant ceiling; existing request, suppression and cost gates still apply. No postal address is collected.
